recordFields.designationReference: Official HES identifier such as LB50078, SM736 or GDL00379.
recordFields.legacyCategoryLabel: Older category notation such as C(S), retained while normalising the app category to C.
recordFields.geometry: WGS84 GeoJSON geometry; null means the geometry must be imported or digitised.
recordFields.locationType: How the geometry represents the asset.
recordFields.dateBasis: The evidential basis for the displayed date.
recordFields.liveRefreshRecommended: Whether current authoritative data should be fetched.

mergeRules: Match statutory records by official designationReference.
Current HES status, category and geometry supersede snapshot values.
Retain manually researched date and narrative fields as local enrichment unless contradicted by the official record.
Preserve unknown dates rather than estimating an exact construction year from map appearance.
